reasonable_RAO_range_definition: All finite linear vessel/CoG response operators on the deployed response band, with arbitrary complex phase, frequency dependence, heading dependence, and cross-axis coupling, provided the resulting execution remains inside the separately declared P1 Normal-Live hard response/source branch. No representative hull, nominal RAO, or discrete RAO catalog is selected.

response_contract.zero_lever_arm_translation_projection: h is the CoG translational projection of an arbitrary finite six-DOF parent RAO; rotational response is handled by the attitude/measurement theorem blocks and is not converted into a fictitious translational lever-arm term
response_contract.finite_response_band_source_note: The lower endpoint is the exact binary32 value of the deployed 0.01f source literal; the physical label remains 0.01 Hz.
response_contract.uniform_moment_theorem: For every finite G, tr(M_disp)<=G^2 H_s^2/16, tr(M_vel)<=omega_hi^2 G^2 H_s^2/16, tr(M_acc)<=omega_hi^4 G^2 H_s^2/16. The proof is algebraic in G; no RAO grid is sampled.
